_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'COMMUNICATIONS DISTRIBUTION MATRIX' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.07.02.

f01_Information_Item_and_Description.label: Information Item and Description
f01_Information_Item_and_Description.guidance: Specific reporting artifact, dashboard, or operational update item being distributed.

f02_Target_Audience_and_Stakeholder_Tier.label: Target Audience and Stakeholder Tier
f02_Target_Audience_and_Stakeholder_Tier.guidance: Designated recipient groups, stakeholder classification, and information consumption level.

f03_Distribution_Channel_and_Delivery_Fo.label: Distribution Channel and Delivery Format
f03_Distribution_Channel_and_Delivery_Fo.guidance: Approved transmission medium (email, portal, automated webhook, executive briefing) and file format.

f04_Cadence_Trigger_and_Schedule.label: Cadence Trigger and Schedule
f04_Cadence_Trigger_and_Schedule.guidance: Recurrence frequency (weekly, monthly, sprint boundary) or specific milestone event triggers.

f05_Responsible_Sender_and_Author.label: Responsible Sender and Author
f05_Responsible_Sender_and_Author.guidance: Designated role or individual accountable for preparing, validating, and sending the update.

f06_Confidentiality_Classification_and_A.label: Confidentiality Classification and Access Controls
f06_Confidentiality_Classification_and_A.guidance: Data sensitivity level (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted) and access control policies.
